summary: Phase 9 features fully validated. Backend pytest: 12/12 PASSED (5 new + 7 regression). /api/sweep returns ranked results with best='Fill 35% bracket' on defaults. /api/projection now includes a complete legacy block (gross_estate, estate_settlement, inherited_ira_tax, tax_free_roth_to_heirs, after_tax_estate_to_heirs, heir_ordinary_rate=0.30, step_up_at_death=true). Editing config (IRA balance, income streams) propagates through projection and legacy. UI: 4 tabs work; PlanInputs editing/add/delete OK on income, expense, account tables; Projection sweep ranks 8 strategies, auto-applies winner (slider 24%->35%), legacy-card populated, export-csv downloads retirement_projection.csv, print-button present; Optimizer & Scenarios regression OK.
critical_code_review_comments: projection.run_projection (~340 lines) is approaching the size where it should be split into smaller helpers (income aggregation, RMD, withdrawals, legacy) for maintainability and unit-testability of each subroutine.
sweep_brackets uses dict(cfg) and dict(cfg['roth']) shallow copy; safe for current keys but a copy.deepcopy(cfg) is more defensive against future nested mutations.

Legacy 'inherited_ira_tax = end_trad * heir_ord_rate' is a simple PV-at-death approximation (does not model the SECURE 10-year stretch). Document this assumption in API/docs and consider exposing as a configurable model.

server.py /api/insights still yields '[Error generating insights: ...]' inside a 200 response on LLM failure; consider emitting a structured terminal token or non-200 status so the UI can show an error state.
Sweep best selection breaks ties by sort-stability only; consider secondary key (e.g., lifetime_taxes asc) when after_tax_estate ties.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ui_* scenario via UI; cleaned up via DELETE /api/scenarios/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/ covers all endpoints incl. /api/sweep (test_phase9_features.py::TestSweep), /api/projection legacy (TestProjectionLegacy), config-edit propagation (TestConfigEdit).
